body: Order total rounds up by one cent versus the line items.

body: Cancelling a paid invoice does not produce a credit note.

body: The hosted payment form takes several seconds to appear.

body: Response times triple during the daily traffic peak.

body: A large CSV export makes every other request hang.

title: cold start takes too long
body: The first request after a deploy takes fifteen seconds.

title: index not used for filter
body: A filtered scan reads the whole table instead of using the index.

title: websocket reconnect storm
body: Clients reconnect in lockstep and saturate the server.

title: cache never warms
body: The result cache misses on every request after a restart.

title: parquet read is single threaded
body: Reading many small files does not parallelise across cores.

body: Joining two wide tables is an order of magnitude slower than expected.

title: gc pause during ingest
body: Long pauses appear while flushing a large event batch.

title: search degrades with volume
body: Text search response time grows linearly with row count.

title: timeseries query scans all days
body: A seven day window still reads every partition on disk.

title: compaction blocks writes
body: Writes stall for the duration of a partition compaction.

title: thumbnail generation is serial
body: Chart thumbnails render one at a time instead of in parallel.

title: connection pool exhausted
body: Requests queue waiting for a free database connection.

title: startup migration is slow
body: Applying migrations on boot adds ten seconds to startup.

title: large payload serialisation
body: Serialising a big response dominates the request time.

title: repeated schema inference
body: Schema is re-inferred on every read instead of being cached.
